options.text: Got any work for me?
I'm looking for a contract.
Put me to use. What needs doing?
Any jobs going for an outsider?
I've got time and a strong back. Need anything done?
What's on the board today?
Give me a task and a price.
I hear your side pays for honest work.
Need an extra pair of hands?
Anything that needs fetching, hauling, or hitting?
I work fast and I keep my mouth shut. Interested?
Let me earn some coin off you.
What would you pay me to handle?
I'm between jobs. Change that.
You look short-handed. I'm available.
Point me at a problem.
Any errands the soldiers won't do?
I can carry, scout, or fight. Pick one.
Is there a contract with my name on it?
Hire me for something.
What's the dirtiest job on your list? I'll take it.
Got anything that pays better than farming?
I need coin. What do you need done?
Give me something useful to do out here.
I want to work off what I did.
Let me sweat for my mistakes.
Give me the jobs nobody wants. I've earned them.
I owe you. Let me pay it in labor.
There must be work that would square us.
Put my debt to use. I'll do the ugly jobs.
I'd rather earn my way back than beg.
Name a task hard enough to matter, and I'll do it.
Let my hands apologize, since my words won't.
Whatever needs doing to fix this, I'll do it.
Hey, got any tasks for me?
Can I do a job for you personally?
Who's hiring around here?
You must have chores you'd pay to skip.
Need someone to cover your shift?
Any way I can earn a few emeralds off you?
I'm for hire. Know anyone who's buying?
What work does the camp need done?
Could you use a hand with anything?
Where do I sign up for paid work?
What's it pay?
Let's talk about the money first.
How many emeralds are we talking?
Is the pay worth my time?
What do I get out of this?
Payment up front or on delivery?
Does the job come with a bonus?
And the reward would be...?
Walk me through the job.
What exactly needs doing?
Give me the details before I decide.
Where would this take me?
How long should this take?
Any fine print I should know about?
Why hasn't one of your own done it?
What's the catch?
How dangerous is it?
Am I likely to get killed doing this?
Will anyone be trying to kill me out there?
What should I bring to survive this?
Rate the danger for me, one to ten.
Has anyone died doing this job?
I'll take the job.
Deal. Consider it done.
Count me in.
You've hired yourself a worker.
I accept. Where do I start?
Fine, I'm on it.
Say no more. I'll handle it.
The contract is mine.
Alright, you talked me into it.
I'll get it done before you miss me.
Shake on it, then.
Done deal. I'm moving.
Not this one. Pass.
I'll sit this job out.
That's not work for me.
Find someone else for that.
The pay doesn't cover the trouble.
No thanks — that job smells like a trap.
I'd rather not, honestly.
Another time, maybe. Not today.
You'll have to sweeten it a lot before I'd touch that.
Hard pass on that one.
Job's done. I'm here to collect.
It's handled. Pay up.
Done and dusted. Where's my reward?
The work is finished, as promised.
Consider your problem solved.
Mission accomplished. Settle the contract.
I did what you asked. Every bit of it.
Finished. And I even enjoyed parts of it.
Your job is complete. My pockets are empty. Fix one of those.
All done. Inspect it if you like.
That task you gave me? History.
Delivered as ordered. Now the coin.
It's done, but it cost me. Never again.
Finished the job. Barely walked away from it.
Done. You undersold how ugly that was.
The work's complete. I've got the scars to prove it.
That was worse than you said. It's done anyway.
Job's finished. Next time, warn me properly.
Still working on that job of yours.
Checking in. The contract's in progress.
Haven't forgotten the work. It's coming along.
The job's underway. Just reporting in.
Your task is half done. Thought you'd want to know.
I'm on it. These things take time.
Progress report: slow but moving.
The work continues. Any advice?
Still alive, still on the job.
Don't worry, the contract hasn't slipped my mind.
Just passing through. The job's not done yet.
Working on it. What's the rush?
I'm dropping the job. Sorry.
I can't finish this contract. I quit.
The work's beyond me. I'm out.
Take the job back. It's not happening.
I give up on the task. Do your worst.
This contract and I are done. Unfinished.
I'm walking away from the job. Keep the pay.
Cancel my contract. I've had enough.

negative: Work? From us? First the ledger, then the labor. That's the order of things.
We give shovels to the trusted and distance to the rest. Guess your prize.
neutral: There's always digging, hauling, bleeding. Pick a shift, get a chit.
The front makes work faster than we make hands. Terms are simple, pay is real.
positive: For you? The board's open, friend. Take the job before the sergeant invents a worse one.
The line has work and you have shoulders. A marriage made in mud.

negative: Tasking flagged individuals requires oversight. Lucky for you, oversight is bored today.
There is work. There is also your file. They are in tension.
neutral: Contracts are posted, scoped, and paid on completion. Interested parties sign here.
We contract civilians for approved taskings. Terms are non-negotiable, payment is prompt.
positive: Good timing, friend. A tasking just cleared for outside hands. Priority one, paperwork zero.
For a proven asset the board opens early. Take your pick of the day sheet.

negative: Work binds two names together. Yours is not yet a name we tie to ours lightly.
The desert has errands, yes. It prefers messengers it has not been burned by.
neutral: There is always a task the wind cannot do alone. Sit, and hear it.
The camp has needs the camp cannot leave to do. Perhaps your feet will serve.
positive: For a friend the good errands surface, like water under the right stone.
The camp trusts your feet and your silence. Both are hired, if you wish.

negative: Work off the debt? Good. Shovels don't forgive, but they do subtract.
The ledger shrinks for sweat. Slowly. Start today, finish maybe never.
You broke it, you dig for it. That's older than any army.
neutral: Debt work is for debtors. Your ledger is clean enough. Take normal wages.
No debt on the books for you. Ask for honest work instead.
positive: Penance? Friend, you owe us nothing but your usual nonsense. Take paid work.
Ha! Your slate is clean. Save the guilt for someone who earned it.

negative: Restitution through labor is provisioned. Completion reduces your infractions. Failure compounds them.
There is a remediation track. It is unpleasant by design. Sign or leave.
Your file has a debit column. Work orders can amend it. Begin immediately.
neutral: No open infractions to work off. Normal contracts are available instead.
Remediation applies to flagged files. Yours is not. Ask for normal tasking.
positive: Your record is green, friend. There is nothing to atone for. Take the good contracts.
Penance requires guilt on file. You have commendations instead. Different queue.

negative: You wish to carry water back to the well you salted. Good. The bucket is heavy. Begin.
Debt walked in on your feet. It can walk out the same way, one errand at a time.
The sand accepts labor where it will not accept words. We will watch you sweat.
neutral: You owe the camp nothing that work would repay. Take an honest task instead.
Penance without sin is theater. The desert dislikes theater. Ask for plain work.
positive: What debt, friend? The fire speaks well of you. Work for wages, not forgiveness.
Your shadow is welcome here. Save your penance for harder rooms.

negative: I don't hand out work. I barely hand out words to you.
Ask the officer. Bring a helmet — his mood throws things.
neutral: Not mine to give. The officer holds the chits.
Work comes from the top. I just do it. Try the command tent.
positive: If I hired you, the sergeant would hire my hide. Officer's tent, friend.
Ha — I'd pay you my whole wage, all three buttons of it. See the officer.

negative: Tasking authority sits above my rank and your reputation. Move along.
I don't issue contracts. I especially don't issue them to flagged files.
neutral: Contracts come from officers or supply. I'm neither. Follow the chain.
Above my authorization. The duty officer handles civilian tasking.
positive: Wish I could hire you myself, friend. Chain of command says see the lieutenant.
I can vouch, not hire. Take my good word to the duty officer.

negative: The hand that pays is not this hand. Ask elsewhere, and softly.
I keep watch, not purses. And on you, I keep more watch than most.
neutral: Errands flow from the elder tents. I am only a rope in the well.
Ask the one who keeps the seal. My work is watching horizons.
positive: For hiring, seek the keeper of the seal, friend. Tell them the night watch smiled on you.
My purse is thin as morning shade. The elder tent has the fat one.

negative: It pays in fewer people scowling at you. Also some coin.
The rate is posted. The grudge discount comes off your end, not ours.
neutral: Emeralds on completion, no advances, no widows' fund for outsiders.
It pays enough to complain about. Payment on delivery, always.
positive: Fair coin and first pull at the stew pot, friend. The stew is the real wage.
It pays honest, plus the sergeant forgets one thing you owe him. Negotiable which thing.

negative: Compensation is scale rate minus your risk premium. The premium is you.
Payment is on the sheet. Consider being offered work at all a concession.
neutral: Rate is fixed per the tasking sheet. Emeralds on verified completion.
Compensation posted with the contract. No completion, no disbursement.
positive: Full scale plus the allied bonus, friend. Finance grumbled. I insisted.
Top rate for you, and I'll expedite the disbursement paperwork myself.

negative: It pays what the desert pays: enough to reach the next well. For you, barely that.
Coin at the end, and the end only. Trust is not part of the wage.
neutral: The purse is fair and opens on completion. The desert honors finished things.
Payment waits at the end of the errand, like shade at the end of a road.
positive: For you the purse opens generously, friend. The elders remember who runs well.
Good coin, and a place by the fire when it's done. The second is worth more.

negative: Details are for the trusted. You get the shape: go there, do it, come back changed or don't.
The job is simple. Watching you attempt it will be the entertainment.
neutral: It's on the chit: what, where, when. The why is above both of us.
Simple work, ugly conditions. Everything here is that sentence.
positive: Sit, friend. Here's the map, the names, the shortcut the sergeant pretends is secret.
Full picture, no varnish. You've earned the honest briefing.

negative: You receive the minimum brief. Operational context is need-to-know. You need to go.
Specifics on acceptance. Your clearance covers the destination and the deadline. Nothing else.
neutral: Brief is on the sheet: objective, boundary, timeline. Deviations void payment.
Scope is defined and non-negotiable. Read twice, sign once.
positive: I'll walk you through the full annex, friend. Including the part command marked optional-to-share.
Here's the brief plus the field notes from last attempt. Learn from the last man's afternoon.

negative: You will know the road when you are on it. Before that, knowing is a privilege.
The errand explains itself to those who begin it. Begin, or leave.
neutral: The task is a story with three parts: the going, the doing, the returning. Hear them in order.
Details are water. We pour when the cup is held steady. Hold steady.
positive: Come close, friend. I will draw the whole road in the sand, wells and dangers both.
For you, the story has no missing verses. Ask anything twice if you need.

negative: Dangerous? Everything here kills something. Mostly time. Sometimes visitors.
You might die. We won't. That's the risk summary.
neutral: Risk is weather. Dress for it. Bring bandages and low expectations.
Somebody's done it before. Somebody's also not come back. Averages out.
positive: Honest, friend? It bites. Pack iron, walk loud, and you'll outlive it.
The job's survivable. I'd send my brother. I don't like my brother, but still.

negative: Threat assessment is classified. Your survival probability is your own project.
Risk exists. Mitigation is available to personnel. You are not personnel.
neutral: Threat level moderate, mapped, and printed on the sheet. Read the sheet.
Normal field risk. Casualty history: within tolerances. Yours may vary.
positive: Straight answer, friend: two known threats, one bad crossing. I've marked all three.
Manageable if you move at dusk and keep the ridge. That's free intel, don't spend it all.

negative: The desert is always hungry. Whether it eats you is between you and the desert.
Danger walks that road, yes. It may recognize you as kin and pass by.
neutral: Every errand has teeth. This one's are small, but it has many.
The road is safe as roads go. Roads go badly sometimes.
positive: I will not send a friend blind. There is one viper on that path — here is where it sleeps.
Small danger, well-mapped. Walk the cold hours and it will miss you, friend.

negative: Taken, then. Fail and the ledger grows teeth.
Good. Work hard. We'll count the result, not the effort.
neutral: Chit's yours. Come back done or don't come back confused.
Signed and shouldered. The front thanks you in advance, quietly.
positive: Ha, that's the spirit! Go, and bring the good news before the bad weather.
Knew you'd take it, friend. The stew will wait for you.

negative: Contract logged. Deadlines are enforced. Excuses are not processed.
Accepted and flagged for monitoring. Perform accordingly.
neutral: Contract is active. Report on completion for verification and payment.
Acknowledged. Tasking is yours. The clock is running.
positive: Outstanding. Tasking assigned to our best available civilian. That's you, friend.
Logged and cleared, friend. Radio silence means you're winning.

negative: So the errand has your name now. Names and errands return together, or not at all.
Go. The task watches you now, as we do.
neutral: It is agreed. The road knows you're coming. Walk it well.
The errand is yours. Return with it finished and the fire will be warm.
positive: Good, friend. May the wind push your back and the sun forget your face.
The camp sleeps easier with this in your hands. Go gently and swift.

negative: Refusing work. Noted in the big sad book of you.
Fine. The trench misses no one.
neutral: Suit yourself. The job won't cry. Jobs never do.
Declined, then. It'll still be here, uglier, tomorrow.
positive: Ha, smart. That job smelled bad to me too. There'll be better.
No harm, friend. The board refills like a bad well.

negative: Declination recorded. Availability rating adjusted downward.
Copy. Removing you from consideration. Some lists you want to be on. This was one.
neutral: Understood. Contract returns to the pool.
Declined and logged. No penalty, no pay, no problem.
positive: Fair call, friend. Not every tasking deserves you.
No stress. First refusal on the next one is still yours.

negative: You refuse. The desert shrugs. The desert has a long memory for shrugs.
As you wish. Some doors close softly. Listen how softly.
neutral: Then the errand waits for other feet. Peace on yours.
A task refused is a story unwritten. Go find your other story.
positive: Wise to know your roads, friend. Another errand will suit you better.
No shadow falls from an honest no. Sit, drink, choose again another day.

negative: Done? Checked. Adequate. The ledger moves one grudging notch.
It's done, yes. So is the arithmetic. Payment, minus nothing, plus nothing.
neutral: Verified. Coin's counted twice, take it once.
Work confirmed. The front notices done things. Briefly, but it notices.
positive: Look at that — finished clean! Coin, stew, and the good bench by the stove, friend.
Done like a Vostok veteran. Take the pay and the compliment. Both are rare.

negative: Completion verified. Payment disbursed. This improves your ledger, not my mood.
Confirmed done. Transaction closed. Punctuality noted despite priors.
neutral: Deliverable verified against the sheet. Payment released. Clean work.
Objective confirmed complete. Disbursing now. Aegis honors its contracts.
positive: Textbook execution, friend. Full pay plus the performance rider. Signed happily.
Verified, exemplary, filed. If you ever want a uniform, I know a recruiter.

negative: The errand returned finished. The purse opens exactly as far as promised. Exactly.
Done is done. Coin is coin. The rest of the ledger is a different afternoon.
neutral: The task came home whole. The purse honors it. Well walked.
Finished as promised. The desert respects a kept word. So do we.
positive: Beautifully done, friend. Coin, dates, and the story told at the fire tonight — you're in it.
The errand sings your praise. Take the purse and the shade both.

negative: It cost you? Everything costs. Welcome to the economy. Here's the pay.
Scars are receipts. Keep them, spend the emeralds.
neutral: Rough jobs make short stories and long drinks. Pay's all there.
You look like the job won on points. But you finished it. That's the whole test.
positive: You went through it, friend. Sit. Stew first, coin second, complaining all night — earned.
Ugly work done well. The line drinks to exactly that. You're the toast tonight.

negative: Field conditions exceeded the brief. Regrettable. Compensation unchanged. Also regrettable.
Hardship acknowledged. Payment is per contract. Sympathy is not a line item.
neutral: Brief underestimated the threat. That feedback goes up the chain. Payment goes to you.
Noted for the after-action: conditions severe. Disbursing full rate.
positive: That tasking went sideways and you still delivered. Hazard bonus approved, friend.
You brought it home through the worst of it. Full pay, my respect, and the medic — any order you like.

negative: The road bit you. Roads do. The purse is the same size regardless of teeth.
You bled for it. The desert drank. The contract is still just a contract.
neutral: Hard roads make honest messengers. The coin is yours, the ache is also yours.
The errand took its toll at the gate. All errands have gates. Payment in full.
positive: You gave the road blood and it gave you passage. Sit, friend — salve, supper, and the full purse.
The fire heard the road was cruel. It saved you the warm side. Coin's in the pouch, double-knotted.

negative: Still unfinished? The ledger yawns. Finish.
In progress is a place between useful and useless. Move.
neutral: Good. Work slow, work sure, work done. Pick two.
Progress noted. The front's still here. So is the deadline.
positive: Take the time it takes, friend. Done right beats done twice.
Steady on. The stew keeps. The job shouldn't, but the stew keeps.

negative: Status logged. Reminder: contracts age poorly. So do second chances.
In progress, acknowledged. The deadline does not share your patience.
neutral: Status received. Continue per the brief. Report at completion.
Copy your progress. No changes to the tasking.
positive: Good copy, friend. Need anything from our end — maps, rations, a kind word?
Progress logged with a green mark. Carry on and stay off the skyline.

negative: The errand is still walking, then. Errands that walk too long start to wander.
We hear you. The task also hears you. It is waiting to be finished.
neutral: The road is long, we know. Walk it to the end and the end will pay.
A task in the hand ripens. Do not let it rot.
positive: No hurry, friend. The desert finishes nothing in a day but the dead.
Walk it at your pace. The fire keeps a place and the purse keeps its weight.

negative: Quitting. Of course. The ledger writes it in the heavy ink.
Dropped like a cold shovel. We'll remember who dug and who didn't.
neutral: Abandoned, then. The job returns to the pile. Your name returns to ordinary.
Fine. Some backs aren't built for some loads. Noted without ceremony.
positive: Eh, it happens, friend. Better a dropped job than a dropped body. Next one's better.
The line forgives a quit faster than a lie. You told it straight. Good enough.

negative: Contract voided. Reliability rating amended. The amendment is unflattering.
Abandonment processed. Future taskings will reflect this datapoint.
neutral: Contract returned to the pool. No payment, a routine notation, nothing personal.
Voided as you asked. The paperwork forgives faster than the officers.
positive: Voiding it clean, friend. Your record holds. Everyone drops one.
Understood. I'll mark it weather-related. Weather takes many forms.

negative: You set the burden down in the open desert. Someone must fetch it now. That is remembered.
An errand released midway is a bird with one wing. Ugly thing to leave behind.
neutral: The task returns to the camp unfinished. The camp sighs and carries on.
So the road refused you, or you refused it. Either way, it ends here.
positive: Set it down, friend. Some loads argue with the shoulder. No shame at this fire.
The errand goes back to the pile, your name stays warm. Rest, then try a kinder road.
